system_prompt_and_action_schema: Original at-most-five-action R1 prefix, Medium effort, no forced earlier submit schema or extra prompt
return_rule: Prefer genuine native submit. Otherwise return latest validated updated belief, explicitly labeled intermediate. Execute earlier retrievals unchanged; do not execute a last unused retrieval after action three.
emergency_rule: No valid model belief -> Beta(4,4) over matching acquired labels. Otherwise retain the most recent valid BLE belief. Never call either a full native submit.
spending_policy: Prepared private per-shared-scope cap at most USD50; no spending or provider change authorized by preparation
selection_basis: Fixed first-two/first-three historical results and existing latency evidence; no fitted threshold, benchmark-specific routing or protected outcomes. Deadline/admission constants are engineering budgets, not tuned against outcomes.
deployment_gate: Exact ZIP validation, evidence equivalence, deadline/error tests, six budgets, concurrent initialization and explicit fresh user approval. No automatic submission.
